title: 150 bass-first chordal sequence candidates in C major
status: Review only; no quiz writes, imports, audio rendering or audio connections

base_range.standard_note_names: C2–C3 bass; overall upper limit G4; C4=MIDI60

important_mapping_note: Existing scripts call MIDI48 app C4; standard scientific notation calls it C3. Numeric pitches are authoritative; confirm the current deployed mapping before import.
construction: Four-note close-position source, second-highest note lowered exactly 12 semitones, then sorted. Bass answer calculated from the final drop-2 voicing. Source shape and dropped note are retained for verification.
first_50_option: Use CBL-001–CBL-050 to add 50; 150 existing +50=200. Full 150 additions would make 300 only if the actual starting count is150.
coverage_policy: Coverage lists exact recorded notes at zero transposition only. Unsupported combinations must be excluded unless the owner and Claude approve an octave adjustment that preserves their bass-range rule. No per-note pitch substitutions.
